name: org.openship/software-alternatives
title: Openship
description: Find open-source alternatives to proprietary business software, with live demos and source code.

tools.name: search_software_alternatives
tools.description: Search a catalog of open-source business software by business type (for example gym, restaurant, salon, hotel, law firm) or by the name of a proprietary product (for example Mindbody, Toast, Shopify). Returns matching open-source products, which proprietary product each one replaces, a feature summary, a live demo link, and a source code link.

query.description: Business type or proprietary product name, e.g. "gym" or "Mindbody".

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Return full details for one open-source product from the catalog: overview, feature groups, who it is for, what it replaces, and demo, source, and documentation links. Accepts a product slug such as openfront-gym or a plain name such as Gym.
